Name: FNAF Plushies
Author: vikich3rry
Description:
Surprise surprise MORE PLUSHIES! But this time they're by the amazing [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/fsfssadsfsfa]fsfssadsfsfa[/url]! This is a Content Patcher conversion of their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19983]AT FNAF plushes[/url] mod, and as a lil extra I also added Circus Baby and Puppet plushies!
[line]
[color=#8e7cc3][size=3][b][i]Features[/i][/b][/size][/color]
🍕The [b]Freddy, Chica, Bonnie, Foxy, Fredbear and Springbonnie plushies[/b] from the original mod, now as [b]new furniture[/b]
🍕New [b]Circus Baby and Puppet plushies[/b], also as [b]new furniture[/b], made by yours truly
🍕All plushies can be found in the [b]Furniture Catalogue[/b], or sometimes in Robin's Shop for 100g
🍕[b]i18n compatible![/b] Includes English and Spanish as of 1.0.0
🍕*[i]Fazbear Entertainment is not responsible for damage to property or person.[/i]
[line]
[b][i][color=#8e7cc3][size=3]Credits[/size][/color][/i][/b]
Once again, many thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/fsfssadsfsfa]fsfssadsfsfa[/url]﻿ for their adorable [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19983]FNAF plushes[/url]﻿ and for letting me share this! Everyone go give them kudos if you like these!
[line]
[color=#d9d2e9][size=2]If you remember when I said [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36964]CatNap[/url] wasn't my first time getting a hyperfixation on the purple villain - yes, William Afton was [i][b]the[/b][/i] hyperfixation.[/size][/color]
[line]
